SahilBloom's advice to stay unshaken by small inconveniences matched it on views (118.1K). In Indochina, Laos is refining its draft 10-year National AI Strategy, and a Vietnam News report says 76.2% of 3,500+ surveyed private firms in Vietnam still use no AI.

indochina_ai.title: Laos advances its draft 10-year National AI Strategy (2026-2035) alongside a satellite strategy: agreed in principle at the September government meeting, now being revised, with priorities on digital infrastructure, databases, skilled people and clear practical AI uses

AI adoption rises in Vietnam but integration stays limited: a VCCI survey of 3,500+ private firms found 76.2% use no AI; an AWS study found 26% of businesses have adopted AI but only 8% have built it into their processes; an AI vision system at a Hanoi firm cut inspection time from 20 to 5 seconds
